definition_en: to tell people about a piece of news in a public or formal way
core_image: 校长站在礼堂台上向全校宣布成绩
scene: 礼堂里，校长站在台上向全校师生宣布成绩。The head teacher announced the exam results.
sceneCN: 这里 announced 是「宣布」（第 1 个义项：公开正式告知）；句意为校长宣布了考试成绩。

senses.title: To announce publicly
senses.definition: to tell a piece of news to people in a public or formal way
senses.definitionCN: 以公开或正式的方式把消息告诉众人
senses.example: The head teacher announced the exam results.
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to report, and reporting news to a whole crowd is the first use.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为报告，把消息报告给整个人群就是第一义。

senses.title: To read out on air
senses.definition: to read out information on radio or television
senses.definitionCN: 在广播或电视上念出信息
senses.example: The radio announced the winner at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 电台在中午播报了获胜者。
senses.why: A voice carrying news to many listeners repeats the old report, now through a microphone.
senses.whyCN: 声音把消息传给许多听众，重复了古老的「报告」，只是改用麦克风。

senses.title: To show something is coming
senses.definition: to make it clear that something is about to happen
senses.definitionCN: 清楚表明某事即将发生
senses.example: Dark clouds announced the storm.
senses.why: When a sign speaks of what comes next, the public telling becomes a silent warning.
senses.whyCN: 当迹象说出了接下来要发生的事，公开告知就变成无声的预警。

definition_en: one more of the same kind, or a different one, or each other

senses.title: One more of the same kind
senses.definition: one more person or thing of the same kind
senses.definitionCN: 同类的人或物再增加一个
senses.example: Would you like another cup of tea?

senses.whyCN: an 加 other 把又一件东西放在第一件旁边，所以新增的那件就是第一义。

senses.whyCN: other 也标记差异，所以这个词也能指向另一类的事物。

senses.title: Each other
senses.definition: each other, used in the fixed phrase one another

definition_en: words given in reply, or the solution to a problem, or a reply to a call
core_image: 老师提问，学生举手回答
scene: 课堂上，老师刚提问，一名学生就举起手回答。She answered the question at once.
sceneCN: 这里 answered 是「回答」（第 1 个义项：口头答复）；句意为她立刻回答了问题。

senses.title: Words in reply
senses.definition: words spoken or written back to a question
senses.definitionCN: 针对提问说回或写回的话
senses.example: She answered the question at once.
senses.why: The old word meant a sworn reply, so words returned to a question are the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 古词意为宣誓后的答复，所以对问题说回去的话是第一义。

senses.title: The correct solution
senses.definition: the correct reply to a problem or a test
senses.definitionCN: 对题目或试题的正确解答
senses.example: The answer to the puzzle is three.
senses.why: A reply is right or wrong, and the right one becomes the solution called an answer.
senses.whyCN: 答复有对有错，正确的那一个就成了所谓答案。

senses.title: To reply to a call
senses.definition: to open the door or pick up the phone when someone calls
senses.definitionCN: 有人叫门或来电时去开门或接听
senses.example: Nobody answered the door.
senses.why: A knock or a ring is also a question, and going to it is answering in action.
senses.whyCN: 敲门或铃声也是一种提问，去回应就是行动上的回答。

senses.title: To be enough for a need
senses.definition: to be enough for what is needed
senses.definitionCN: 足以应付需要
senses.example: This small room answers our need.
senses.exampleCN: 这间小房间满足了我们的需要。
senses.why: When a thing replies to a demand by being enough, the reply sense turns into satisfying.
senses.whyCN: 当某物以「足够」来回应需求，回答之义就转成满足。

definition_en: a part of a place, or the size of a surface, or a field of activity
core_image: 城市地图上被圈出的一片安静街区
scene: 城市边缘有一片安静的街区，街上几乎没有车。This area of the city is very quiet.
sceneCN: 这里 area 是「地区」（第 1 个义项：一块划出的地方）；句意为城市的这一片区域非常安静。

senses.title: A part of a place
senses.definition: a part of a town, a country or the world
senses.definitionCN: 城镇、国家或世界的一部分
senses.example: This area of the city is very quiet.
senses.exampleCN: 城市的这一片区域非常安静。
senses.why: The Latin word named open ground, so a stretch of ground marked off is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词指开阔地面，所以划出来的一片地面就是第一义。

senses.title: The size of a surface
senses.definition: the amount of flat surface measured in square units
senses.definitionCN: 以平方单位量出的平面大小
senses.example: The area of the room is twenty square metres.
senses.exampleCN: 这间房间的面积是二十平方米。
senses.why: Measuring that open ground turns a stretch of space into a number of square units.
senses.whyCN: 量一量那片空地，就把空间变成若干平方单位。

senses.title: A field of activity
senses.definition: a subject or a part of activity that has its own limits
senses.definitionCN: 有自身边界的一个学科或活动范围
senses.example: She works in the area of science.
senses.why: A ground marked off can also be marked off in thought, which gives the sense of a field of work.
senses.whyCN: 地面上划出的一块也能在思想上划出，于是有「工作领域」。

definition_en: to disagree in words, or to give reasons for an opinion, or to persuade someone with reasons
core_image: 两个男孩指着最后一个座位争执
scene: 两个男孩为了最后一个座位争了起来，声音越来越高。The two boys argued about the last seat.
sceneCN: 这里 argued 是「争论」（第 1 个义项：用言语争执）；句意为两个男孩为最后一个座位争吵。

senses.title: To disagree in words
senses.definition: to speak against someone because you disagree
senses.definitionCN: 因意见不同而用言语对抗
senses.example: The two boys argued about the last seat.
senses.exampleCN: 两个男孩为最后一个座位争吵。
senses.why: Two people pressing opposite views in words gives the first sense of the verb.
senses.whyCN: 两个人用话语各推一边，就是这个词的第一义。

senses.title: To give reasons for an opinion
senses.definition: to give reasons to show that an opinion is right
senses.definitionCN: 给出理由以说明某个看法是对的
senses.example: She argued that the plan was too costly.
senses.exampleCN: 她论证说这个计划成本太高。
senses.why: Making a matter clear by reasons is the older Latin sense, kept in the arguing of a case.
senses.whyCN: 用理由把事情说清是更早的拉丁义，保留在「论证」这个用法里。

senses.title: To persuade with reasons
senses.definition: to persuade someone to do something by giving reasons
senses.definitionCN: 通过讲理由劝人做某事
senses.example: He argued her into joining the team.
senses.why: The same reasons aimed at changing a mind become the act of persuading.
senses.whyCN: 同样的理由用来改变别人的想法，就成了说服。

definition_en: the limb from shoulder to hand, or weapons, or to supply with weapons

sceneCN: 这里 arm 是「手臂」（第 1 个义项：肩到手之间的肢体）；句意为她抬起手臂挥手。

senses.title: The limb of the body
senses.definition: the part of the body between the shoulder and the hand
senses.definitionCN: 肩与手之间的身体部分
senses.example: She raised her arm to wave.
senses.why: The old English word named this limb, so the body part is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 古英语词指这条肢体，所以身体部位就是第一义。

senses.title: Weapons
senses.definition: weapons used for fighting
senses.definitionCN: 用于战斗的武器
senses.example: The soldiers laid down their arms.
senses.why: Weapons are held in the arm, so the limb gave its name to what it carries.
senses.whyCN: 武器要用手臂持握，于是这条肢体把名称借给了所持之物。

senses.title: To supply with weapons
senses.definition: to give weapons to a person or a group
senses.definitionCN: 把武器交给某个人或某个群体
senses.example: The guards were armed with sticks.
senses.exampleCN: 守卫们拿着棍棒当武器。
senses.why: Giving a person what the arm carries turns the noun into the verb of arming.
senses.whyCN: 把手臂所持之物交给某人，就把名词变成动词「武装」。

scene: 湖边一圈都长着树，水面被围在中间。Trees grow around the lake.

senses.title: On every side
senses.definition: on every side of something, enclosing it

senses.whyCN: 绕着一点移动而不定死，就得到数量上「大约」的宽松义。

senses.title: In many places
senses.definition: from one place to another without a fixed direction
senses.definitionCN: 没有固定方向地从一处到另一处

senses.whyCN: 同样的绕圈被展开成游走，于是有「四处」的义项。

definition_en: creative work such as painting or music, or the making of pictures, or a skill gained by practice
core_image: 学生在画布上画一片风景
scene: 教室里，学生正用画笔在画布上画一片风景。She studies art at school.
sceneCN: 这里 art 是「艺术」（第 1 个义项：绘画音乐等创作）；句意为她在学校学习艺术。

senses.title: Creative work
senses.definition: creative work such as painting, music or writing
senses.definitionCN: 绘画、音乐或写作这类创造性作品
senses.example: She studies art at school.
senses.why: The Latin word meant skill, and skill put into beautiful making becomes creative work.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词意为技艺，技艺用于美的制作就成了创造性作品。

senses.title: The making of pictures
senses.definition: the making of pictures and sculptures
senses.definitionCN: 绘画与雕塑的创作
senses.example: The gallery shows modern art.
senses.exampleCN: 美术馆展出当代美术作品。
senses.why: Among the arts, the ones made for the eye keep the plain name art in everyday use.
senses.whyCN: 在各种艺术中，为眼睛而作的那一类在日常里保留 art 这个朴素名称。

senses.title: A skill gained by practice
senses.definition: a skill that is learned by long practice
senses.definitionCN: 经长期练习而获得的技能
senses.example: Letter writing is a lost art.
senses.exampleCN: 写信是一门失传的技艺。
senses.why: The oldest sense was simply skill, and any practised craft can still be called an art.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项只是「技艺」，任何练熟的功夫至今都能称作 art。

intro.en: The recorded history of art is set out below; the deeper origin is marked where it is uncertain.
intro.cn: 下面是 art 有记录的历史；更早的来源存疑处已作标注。

items.en: Ars meant skill, craft or a trained method.
items.cn: ars 意为技艺、手艺或训练有素的方法。

items.en: The form artis carried the same sense of skill.
items.cn: 形式 artis 同样表示技艺。

items.en: French art kept both the craft and the fine-art sense.
items.cn: 法语 art 同时保留手艺与美术两种含义。

items.en: English used art for skill before it meant fine art.
items.cn: 英语十三世纪先用 art 指技艺，后指美术。

items.en: Today it covers galleries, classrooms and old crafts.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖美术馆、课堂与古老手艺。

note.en: The first group collects forms that look or sound alike; the second group collects words with a nearby meaning.
note.cn: 第一组收形近或音近的词，第二组收意义相近的词。

entries.definitionCN: 指多个艺术门类的复数。

entries.definitionCN: 指能力本身，不含美的意味。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the recorded form, the real family and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用有记录的词形、真实的词族和这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Ars meant skill: art begins as a trained way of making, and beauty follows the skill.
normal.cn: ars 意为技艺：art 起初是训练有素的制作方式，美随技艺而来。

normal.en: The same family also gives artist and artistic.
normal.cn: 同一词族还给出 artist 与 artistic。

normal.en: It often appears in the phrase modern art.
normal.cn: 它常出现在「现代艺术」这个搭配里。

normal.en: Spell it as it sounds: keep every letter of art in order.
normal.cn: 按读音拼写：把 art 的每个字母按顺序保留。

normal.en: Use it when you mean: creative work such as painting or music, or the making of pictures, or a skill gained by practice.
normal.cn: 当你想表达「艺术」时用它。

abstract.en: Picture a pupil painting a landscape on a canvas.
abstract.cn: 想象学生在画布上画一片风景。

abstract.en: The same picture can be literal in one sentence and figurative in another.
abstract.cn: 同一幅画面在一句里可以是字面意思，在另一句里可以是比喻。

abstract.en: Say the word aloud first, then let the picture bring the meaning back.
abstract.cn: 先把这个词读出声，再让画面把意思带回来。
